integrity: Analytical proof is self-contained; executable standard-library simulation corroborates selected parameter instances only. Reproduction is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Almost-sure asymptotics for finite edge-proportional sampling with strictly positive interior initial weights, strict update factors, and both eventually stabilized classes; not quantitative finite-time guarantees, global stabilization, or an empirical social prediction.
title: Universal logarithmic sampling of discordant ties with persistent receptive edges
